channel.title: Crypto Infrastructure Ledger
channel.description: Independent crypto reporting for validators and node operators, tracing client upgrades, hardware costs, and the work of keeping networks running.

item.title: ME Network V2.0.17 passes vote, putting nodes on a clock
item.description: Validators approved V2.0.17 unanimously, setting a block-height cutover that favors safer address checks but demands a rehearsed eight-hour recovery window.

item.title: How Liquidity-Based Withdrawals Actually Settle
item.description: Liquidity-based withdrawals are paid from available cash and executable positions, while queues, haircuts, and delays transfer risk to the requester.

item.title: Cross-Chain Swaps Trade Assets; Transfers Move Them
item.description: Cross-chain swaps exchange one asset for another across networks, while transfers move the same value; the route determines fees, trust, and failure risk.
